sn35.94:3.1: saḷeva → chaḷeva (bj, sya-all, pts) | bhikkhavo → bhikkhave (sya-all) | Saḷeva → chaḷeva (cck: ka.)
sn35.94:4.4: cāppiyaṁ → cappiyaṁ (bj) | na cāppiyaṁ meti → nacappiyam me ti (pts) | cappiyaṁ → na cāppiyaṁ (bj: syā, machasaṁ)
sn35.94:5.4: cāppiyaṁ meti manaṁ → cappiyam me ti manam (pts)
sn35.94:6.2: ghatvā → ghātvā (bj) | athopi ghatvā asuciṁ → atho pi ghātvā asucim (pts)
sn35.94:7.1: bhotvāna asāditañca → bhotvā sāditañca (bj) | bhotvāna asāditañca sāduṁ → bhotvā paritaṁ ca sādu (sya-all) | sāduṁ → paritañca sādu (bj: syā); sāditañcasāduṁ (bj: sī.pavi); asāditañca sāduṁ (bj: machasaṁ); sāditañcasāduñca (bj: sīmu)
sn35.94:7.3: bhuñje virodhamāsādusu nopadaṁsaye → bhuñjati virodhamāsādu suno padaṁsaye (sya-all)
sn35.94:8.1: majje → majjhe (bj: syā, sī.pavi) | majje → majjhe (cck: syā. kaṁ. pī.)
sn35.94:8.3: sukhadukkhe → sukhadukkhaṁ (sya-all) | upekkhe → upekho (pts) | sukhadukkhe → sukhadukkhaṁ (bj: syā) | upekkhe → upekkho (bj: sīmu)
sn35.94:10.3: rāgadose → rāgadosaṁ hi (sya-all) | rāgadose → rāgadosaṁ (bj: sīmu)
sn35.94:10.4: bhavattha → bhavātha (bj) | pāragāti paṭhamaṁ → pāragā ti (pts) | bhavātha → bhavattha (bj: machasaṁ) | Bhavattha → bhavatha (cck: sī. syā. kaṁ.)
